verdict.rationale: ADK is a Python framework/CLI (adk run, adk web, adk eval, adk deploy) with documented programmatic APIs for building and driving agents, plus MCP client/server support, but there is no evidence of a formal public REST/OpenAPI-style API surface — probes for openapi/swagger specs and llms.txt all 404. missing for 10: a documented public HTTP/OpenAPI API spec, independent third-party confirmation of programmatic drivability beyond first-party docs.
